newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares end mixed, Olivetti and Compart star.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares end mixed, Olivetti and Compart star.

text.p: Italian shares closed mixed on Friday as late profit-taking set in after a week of sustained rises. Trading volume was good, estimated at over one trillion lire ($660 million), inflated by technical factor of futures and options expiries.
"It was a mixed sesssion, a pause for relection after recent gains," one dealer said.
Olivetti and industrial holding group Compart led among gainers but Fiat hit by profit-taking.
The all-share Mibtel index closed up 0.05 percent at 10,328 but the Mib 30 blue chip index ended down 0.05 percent at 15,517.

High-tech group Olivetti shares ended 4.13 percent up at 560 lire in volume of over 62 million shares as the market focused on developments regarding the sale of its troubled PC business. But Carlo De Benedetti's Cofide financial holding slumped 9.75 percent to 720 on selling after recent gains.

Compart, formerly Ferruzzi Finanziaria, continued to rise helped by technical buying, possible group disposals and merger talk with its sister company Montedison. Compart closed 5.93 percent higher at 627.3 lire.
Energy group ENI gained 0.92 percent to 7,708 but Fiat ended 1.59 percent down at 4,530 lire.

Telecoms were mixed as the market speculated over the future structure of the sector. Telecom Italia put on 2.07 percent to 3,545 lire and Stet holding company edged 0.21 percent higher to 6,187, but mobile phone operator TIM was off again, down 2.59 percent to 3,387 lire.

Insurances were generally firmer, with SAI up 7.36 percent at 14,070 lire, Toro up 3.46 percent at 21,212, La Fondiaria up 2.12 percent at 5,984 and INA up 1.82 percent to 2,243. But Alleanza slipped 0.66 percent to 11,167 and RAS fell 0.69 percent to 15,159 lire. $1=1,517 lire
